# Tril$oft VST Division

> Weird VSTs no one asked for. Tril$oft is an independent developer selling audio plug-ins.

## Plug-ins

Paid plug-ins are listed first. MIDI Fart Sniffer stays last.

- [Wild Card](https://vst.trilsoft.com/wildcard): DJ scratch VST for MIDI DJ controllers, tested with the Hercules DJControl Starlight. $13.
- [Conceal-N-Strike](https://vst.trilsoft.com/conceal-n-strike): 64-step turntablism sequencer where each step has a platter CONCEAL move and a fader STRIKE cut. $15 launch price, $19 after launch.
- [MIDI Fart Sniffer](https://vst.trilsoft.com/midi-fart-sniffer): MIDI groove browser. Point it at a folder of drum MIDI and it plays the groove into your drums, locked to the host tempo and bar. VST3, CLAP, Audio Unit, Max for Live, and a standalone macOS app. Free. The page emails the key; that address is only used to send the key and is stored hashed.

## Support

- [Help](https://vst.trilsoft.com/privacy): Questions go to help@trilsoft.com.
- [Wild Card mapping](https://vst.trilsoft.com/wildcard): Controller mapping requests use the subject "Wild Card Mapper Request" to help@trilsoft.com.

## Policies

- [FAQ](https://vst.trilsoft.com/faq): Answers on the plug-ins, formats, keys, installers, refunds, and contact. Nothing is hidden in a toggle.
- [Privacy](https://vst.trilsoft.com/privacy): Tril$oft sets no cookies of its own and does not collect visitor data.
- [Refunds](https://vst.trilsoft.com/faq#refunds): Digital sales are final, with no automatic refunds. If a plug-in won't install, activate, or work as the page says, email help@trilsoft.com. Replies come as life permits.
- [Installers](https://vst.trilsoft.com/faq#installers): macOS only. Current version 0.1.0. Stable newest installers: Wild Card https://github.com/Echooff3/vst-public-releases/releases/download/wildcard-latest/Wild-Card-macOS.pkg, Conceal-N-Strike https://github.com/Echooff3/vst-public-releases/releases/download/conceal-n-strike-latest/Conceal-N-Strike-macOS.pkg, MIDI Fart Sniffer https://github.com/Echooff3/vst-public-releases/releases/download/midi-fart-sniffer-latest/MIDI-Fart-Sniffer-macOS.pkg. All versions: https://github.com/Echooff3/vst-public-releases/releases. Paid plug-ins need the key from the Buy Now email. MIDI Fart Sniffer's key comes from Get Free Key.

## How it works

- [Wild Card](https://vst.trilsoft.com/wildcard): Run the installer, put it on a MIDI track, activate with the code from your purchase email, load a sample, then scratch on a Hercules DJControl Starlight or by scrolling the record.
- [Conceal-N-Strike](https://vst.trilsoft.com/conceal-n-strike): Run the installer, drop it on an instrument track, activate with the code from your purchase email, then program each of 64 steps with a platter CONCEAL move and a fader STRIKE cut.
- [MIDI Fart Sniffer](https://vst.trilsoft.com/midi-fart-sniffer): Enter an email on the page and the key is sent there. The address is only used to send the key and is stored hashed. Run the installer, activate with that code, open a folder of drum MIDI, click a groove, and route the MIDI into a drum instrument. In Live use the Max for Live device or a second track's MIDI From. In Logic use the MIDI FX slot.
